62. 
Rationale: Dominica spends significant fiscal resources on goods and services through its 
procurement system, particularly in the aftermath of natural disasters and other climate change-induced 
shocks. Having a green and efficient procurement system enables increased competition, more 
transparency and better value for money, generating efficiencies and fiscal savings over the medium-
term. Public procurement in Dominica is currently governed by an outdated, deficient set of regulations 
that does not reflect the many advances in public procurement. In addition, Dominica is currently utilizing 
a manual procurement system and moving to an e-procurement system will provide business continuity 
during natural disasters and improve efficiency in the procurement process. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
